AI Draftsman · Shop Drawings & 3D

Plans In. Shop Drawings, 3D Model and BOQ Out.

Upload the architectural plans and AI Quantora Draftsman designs every system you choose — fire, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, ELV and civil — then issues the shop drawings, riser schematics, take-off markup drawings and a 3D coordination model, to your country’s authority rules and the project specification.

  • 3D model of every floor and system, with plant rooms (fire pumps, tanks, FAHU), downloadable as IFC and .glb
  • Shop drawings and schematics with reference numbers. Every revision (R0, R1, R2 …) is kept
  • Markup drawing with every item highlighted and numbered against the BOQ
  • AC layout like an approved shop drawing: area sheets at 1:200 with a key plan, fan coil units, duct sizes and airflow
  • Rework on consultant comments, with clouds and a response sheet; the drawing number stays the same

The Shop Drawing Studio

From Architectural Plan To Issued Shop Drawing

A draughtsman does four things before a sheet can be issued: establish the base plan, read what the specification binds, size the system to the code of the authority having jurisdiction, and set it out. The studio does them in that order, and shows its working at every step.

01

Base Plan & Scale

  • Reads the room enclosures off your architectural PDF
  • Takes the scale from the sheet, or calibrates it from one known dimension
  • Types every room — office, corridor, plant, car park
  • Kept against the project, so it is read once
Architectural · structural · floor plans
02

Specification Review

  • Every page searched in your browser
  • Tells you which pages specify each system
  • Or type the page numbers straight from the contents list
  • Each value returned with its page and its clause
Mounting height · coverage · IP · cable
03

Design & Calculation

  • 33 MEP, ELV, fire and public health systems
  • Device schedule, mounting heights, containment and cable
  • Plant sizing, riser and single-line schematics
  • Every quantity carries the code clause it came from
NFPA · ASHRAE · SIRA · SBC · local AHJ
04

Shop Drawing Production

  • General notes and design basis on sheet QE-000
  • Layouts per level, per discipline, with legend and north point
  • Containment routed from the floor IDF along the corridor spine
  • Title block, revision, scale bar — SVG, DXF or print
Issued for review · DXF to AutoCAD

Every Drawing Says What It Was Built On

Sheet QE-000 leads the set with three registers side by side, because three different things bind a shop drawing and they are not the same thing. A reviewer can check any figure on any layout without asking anybody where it came from.

Register 01

Client Instructions

Building type, levels, gross area, specification grade, floor-to-floor, scope of works, the systems instructed, and every device count fixed by hand. Each one referenced to the project record.

Register 02

Specification Instructions

Every accepted requirement and every binding clause, each referenced to the document and the page number it was read from. A coverage figure here changes the device count on every level.

Register 03

Authority Instructions

The authority having jurisdiction for the project's city, and the code clauses that actually produced a quantity on this set. Not a list of standards — the rules that fired.

Global Coverage

Compliance that follows your project, wherever it is

Choose the country and city, and Quantora applies that jurisdiction's authorities, approvals, certificates and codes — not a generic checklist. 532 regulatory rules across 20 countries, 17 system categories each, from the Middle East and Asia to the UK, Europe, the Americas and Australia. Where a city has its own authority it takes precedence; everywhere else the national requirement applies automatically.

Middle East (GCC)

UAE — all seven emirates, each with its own Civil Defence
Dubai: DCD, DEWA and SIRA · Abu Dhabi: ADCDA, TAQA and ADMCC
Saudi Arabia — Civil Defense (Salamah), SEC and the Saudi Building Code
Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman — QCDD, KFF, Kahramaa, CDAA
UAE guideSaudi guide

South Asia

India — National Building Code 2016 and the IS codes
State Fire NOC resolved per city, Mumbai to Ahmedabad
CEA Regulations and the state Electrical Inspectorate
Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh
India guide

South East Asia & Hong Kong

Singapore — SCDF Fire Code, SS 638, PUB and IMDA
Malaysia — Bomba Fire Certificate and UBBL 1984
Indonesia, Philippines (BFP, RA 9514), Thailand, Vietnam
Hong Kong — FSD, Buildings Department and EMSD
Singapore guide

UK & Europe

United Kingdom — Building Regulations, BS 5839, BS 7671, BS EN 12845
Germany — DIN 14675, VdS, DIN VDE 0100 · France — NF S 61-970, NF C 15-100
Rest of the EU — EN 54, EN 12845, HD 60364 and EN 1838 emergency lighting
Every line states the standard it was checked against
Full authority rule sets for EU states: coming soon
UK guide

Americas, Africa & Australia

United States — NFPA 72, NFPA 13/20, NEC · Canada — CAN/ULC-S524, CSA C22.1
Australia and New Zealand — AS 1670.1, AS 2118 and AS/NZS 3000
South Africa, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria and Ethiopia — national codes named
Anywhere else — falls back to IEC, ISO and EN standards, and says so
Industries

Built for the Trades That Price Buildings

Quantora is tuned for MEP and ELV scope — the systems most takeoff tools handle worst, because they live in schedules, risers and symbol legends rather than simple areas and counts.

ELV & Security Contractors
CCTV, access control, intercom, public address, IPTV and ANPR — with camera schedules, device counts and VMS licensing derived automatically.
MEP Subcontractors
HVAC, FCU and AHU layouts, ducting, plumbing, drainage and pump rooms — read from equipment schedules as well as floor plans.
Electrical Contractors
Lighting, power distribution, DB panels, cable sizing, containment, earthing and lightning protection, with accessories and consumables included.
Fire & Life Safety
Fire alarm, fire fighting, sprinkler and fire pump scope, checked against the local authority rules that apply to your project's city.
Quantity Surveyors & Estimators
Full traceability on every line — see whether a quantity came from a physical count, a schedule or a calculation before you put it in a tender.
Developers & Consultants
Independent check of a contractor's submitted BOQ, and early budget quantities before drawings are fully issued.
